GNU ld link maps of the release TUI statically link crt2.o, crtbegin.o, crtend.o, mingw-w64 runtime members of libmingw32.a and libmingwex.a, import stubs of libkernel32.a, libmsvcrt.a and libntdll.a, _ctors.o from libgcc.a and unwind-seh.o from libgcc_eh.a; no winpthreads member is linked. Unoptimized builds also take import stubs from libuserenv.a and libws2_32.a, so both are fingerprinted. The executable imports only Windows system DLLs, which are not redistributed, and needs no MinGW runtime DLL. Preserve the full Rust standard-library aggregate, the mingw-w64 attribution including the ZPL-2.1 terms and disclaimer, and the GCC attribution with GPLv3 and the included GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1, which covers the linked libgcc objects. Other builder revisions or targets require review.
description: Rust 1.98.1 standard-library notices and Debian Bookworm mingw-w64 runtime/startup attribution for Windows. Rust compiler implementation dependencies are excluded. mingw-w64 startup, runtime and import-library objects and GCC runtime objects are statically linked into the executable; Windows system DLLs are not bundled. This record is limited to the fingerprinted x86_64-w64-mingw32 cross inputs installed in the official rust:1.98.1-bookworm image.

reviewNotes: Reviewed the self-contained objects of rust-std-1.98.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl: crt1.o, rcrt1.o, Scrt1.o, crti.o, crtn.o and libc.a are musl 1.2.5, pinned by rust-lang/rust 1.98.1 src/ci/docker/scripts/musl.sh with the CVE-2026-6042 and CVE-2026-40200 patches of musl-toolchain.sh, and built by musl-cross-make GCC 9.4.0 according to their .comment sections and debug paths. libunwind.a is LLVM libunwind and crtbegin*.o/crtend*.o are compiler-rt's crtbegin.c and crtend.c, all from rust-lang/llvm-project 52ed14fcd56afc30f9cccd8ca8ce237c2eef7e04, the src/llvm-project submodule of Rust 1.98.1. legal/manual holds musl's v1.2.5 COPYRIGHT and that commit's libunwind and compiler-rt LICENSE.TXT byte for byte. x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc only drives the link: the map shows no GCC startup or runtime object, and the static executable has no NEEDED entry. MIT and Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception need only these notices; no source offer applies. Other builder revisions or targets require review.
description: Rust 1.98.1 standard-library notices plus musl libc 1.2.5 and LLVM runtime attribution for the static x86_64-unknown-linux-musl TUI and server. Rust's self-contained musl startup objects and libc.a, LLVM libunwind (libunwind.a) and compiler-rt's crtbegin/crtend are linked into the executable, which imports no system library. This record is limited to the fingerprinted amd64 inputs of the rustup x86_64-unknown-linux-musl standard library in the official rust:1.98.1-bookworm image.
